author: DJI
description:
Unleash exceptional cinematic versatility with its dual-camera system, capturing everything from sweeping landscapes to intricate close-ups. The wide-angle camera features an enhanced 1-inch CMOS sensor with up to 17 stops of dynamic range, while the 10-bit D-Log 2 profile unlocks boundless creative freedom in post-production. The 60mm medium-telephoto lens with an f/1.8 aperture creates natural bokeh, elevating portraits with stunning depth. Get closer with up to 18× zoom.

Capture every highlight in 4K/240fps slow motion with D-Log support—all packed into a refined Pearl White body that slips right into your pocket.

✅ Dual Cameras | Cinematic Shots Near & Far 
✅ 3-Axis Stabilization & ActiveTrack 9.0 | Up to 18× Zoom
✅ 4K/240fps Slow Motion with D-Log Support
✅ New D-Log 2 | Light & Shadow Precision 
✅ Enhanced 1-Inch CMOS & Up to 17 Stops of Dynamic Range 
✅ Classic Focal Length for Standout Portraits
✅ In-Camera Live Photo Support 
✅ Two Color Options | Sleek and Sophisticated

👉
title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P is now available in Pearl White — the Dual-Camera Cinematic Pocket Gimbal Camera.
